investigations.name: og-00-vent-reactor-baseline
investigations.title: The Serpentinizing Vent
investigations.objective: Can a Lost City–like, serpentinization-fed vent–ocean interface reproduce observed fluid mixing, heat transport, mineral precipitation and H2/alkalinity delivery under field-constrained conditions — with no origin-of-life claim?
investigations.claim: Habitability is a bounded REGION of the operating space, not a single tuned run: across the (olivine reaction rate × flow velocity) grid the real PHREEQC + FiPy serpentinizing vent settles inside the Lost City window — T 40–91 °C AND pH 9.0–10.8 AND a positive H2 flux — over ~80% of the swept grid, and the baseline operating point sits safely inside it (T 50.6 °C, pH 9.37) with sustained H2, exact charge balance (|charge|=0) and FiPy flux divergence within the contract tolerance (4.9e-5 vs the 1e-3 bound).

investigations.name: og-01-cal-electrochemistry
investigations.title: The Vent Wall as a Galvanic Cell: Which Limitation Stops Carbon Fixation, and Do the Model Classes Agree?
investigations.objective: Model Upgrade plan, Phase 2 (electrochemical carbon fixation). og-01 drives CO2 reduction with a scalar gradient_efficiency and a Michaelis drive in the proton-motive force, so it can say WHETHER fixation runs but not WHY it stops. Treating the vent wall as an electrical circuit instead — fluid redox state -> Nernst electrode potentials -> Butler-Volmer overpotentials -> current density -> surface rates — which limitation (thermodynamic, electrical, catalytic, transport) binds where over (vent pH x dissolved H2 x mineral conductivity x Ni/Fe), and do the empirical and the electrochemical model classes on the new carbon_fixation face agree on that label in the region both call favorable?
investigations.claim: Explicit electrochemistry is feasible, calibrated and ledger-exact, and it changes the answer to "why does fixation stop": under the Butler-Volmer class the alkaline-vent cell is activation-limited everywhere the wall conducts — the catalyst, not the gradient, binds — and the Tutolo-style collapse is an electrical regime below ~1e-6 S/m that both classes recover. The empirical class cannot make that attribution because its one Michaelis drive term lumps electrical and catalytic limitation and its substrate Michaelis constant invents a transport limit the cell physics does not have. The failure-mode label is therefore structure-sensitive (agreement 0.47 < 0.8): a negative result on the gate and the Phase-2 mechanism map the plan asked for, recorded as a decision for the expert rather than hidden.

investigations.name: og-01-geology-to-reduced-carbon
investigations.title: The First Carbon
investigations.objective: Which combinations of T, pH, pressure, H2, CO2 and mineralogy generate sustained net organic-carbon flux across the interface — reproducing Hudson/Preiner/Altair regimes before any extrapolation?
investigations.claim: H2-driven CO2 reduction over Fe/Ni/S reproduces the Preiner/Hudson lab yields and net organic-carbon flux in a bounded favorable regime; the Tutolo-2026 arm shows the usable proton-motive gradient collapses at in-situ T/P (427 -> 43 mV), roughly halving the sustained flux; only the no-gradient / no-H2 / no-catalyst controls zero it.

investigations.name: og-02-alt-reaction-universe
investigations.title: The Open Network: Do Autocatalytic Motifs Emerge From Rule-Generated Chemistry, Beyond Chance?
investigations.objective: Model Upgrade plan, Phase 3. og-02 showed a hand-curated rTCA fragment persists and self-amplifies under flow — but its autocatalytic turn (OAA + 2 CO2 -> 2 OAA + acetate) was written into the network. If the network is instead GENERATED from a Wolos-2020-style rule set over C1-C3 feedstock with real eQuilibrator thermodynamics, catalyst limits and degradation, and fed the Phase-1 posterior vent state, do persistent autocatalytic subnetworks appear at all, are they more frequent than in matched null networks, and how does the curated rTCA class compare when all three are graded by one post-hoc detector and one element / free-energy ledger?
investigations.claim: With real thermodynamics and conservation, autocatalysis is not free: the generated universe fed the Phase-1 vent posterior builds a persistent, element-balanced, dissipative network but no autocatalytic motif, because every C-C-forming route is uphill at vent concentrations; the one motif that does emerge — the formose cycle, recovered post hoc from the rules, absent in every matched null — needs a formaldehyde supply the vent chemistry does not make and a residence time shorter than its reductive destruction. The curated rTCA result survives as one class among three, with its motif now classed as imposed and its stoichiometry flagged as non-conserving.
baseline_names: Open chemical network — reaction_universe at the Phase-1 feed

investigations.name: og-02-reduced-carbon-to-protometabolism
investigations.title: The First Metabolism
investigations.objective: Under continuous feed and washout, do reaction subnetworks become self-reinforcing — persistent cycles, flux amplification, product reuse, autocatalytic motifs — without imposed product accumulation?
investigations.claim: A curated rTCA-fragment network under continuous feed + washout sustains nonzero carbon throughput, exhibits an autocatalytic motif (OAA self-amplification, autocatalytic gain peaking ~29.5), and forms a single connected reaction network — metabolism-like behavior emerging without imposed product accumulation.

investigations.name: og-03-dilution-to-localized-individuals
investigations.title: The First Individual
investigations.objective: Where in pore geometry (openness × length) does a real thermophoretic + convective trap concentrate a dilute vent feed across the localization threshold — the point at which a bounded, concentrated "individual" forms rather than washing through?
investigations.claim: Localization is real and robust: a real FiPy thermophoretic + convective trap concentrates a dilute vent feed into a bounded REGION of pore geometry, mapped natively over (porosity × pore length) — long, tight pores localize strongly (a persistent local "individual" emerges) while open / short pores wash the feed through (enrichment ~1). The EXTENT of enrichment the favourable trap reaches (reduced-model estimate ~1e6–1e7-fold at accumulation Péclet ≈ 18) is a solver-sensitive extrapolation above Pe ≈ 13, not a precise resolved result — the defensible claim is that localization occurs, not the exact fold-magnitude (Baaske 2007).

investigations.name: og-04-mineral-compartments-to-protocells
investigations.title: The First Boundary
investigations.objective: Do mixed-amphiphile organic boundaries enhance persistence without cutting the system off from geochemical energy?
investigations.claim: Mixed single-chain amphiphiles form viable vesicles across the alkaline / seawater-salt window where single fatty acids fail (Jordan 2019), and those compartments retain internal chemistry while staying permeable to the gradient — a non-empty individuality-without-isolation region.

investigations.name: og-05-environmental-to-internal-bioenergetics
investigations.title: Owning Its Energy
investigations.objective: Can selection move from externally imposed gradients toward internally maintained electrochemical states (catalytic ion transport then pumping)?
investigations.claim: Survival off a collapsing gradient is a bounded REGION of (pump catalyst efficiency × gradient floor), mapped by a real replicator sweep — a lineage persists either by riding a floor that never falls too far OR by internalizing gradient generation, but internalizing only pays above the Sojo cost line (η ≈ 0.30). At the operating point an efficient pump internalizes (pump fraction 0→0.95) and survives while a weak pump collapses — the Sojo-2014 leaky-membrane constraint on bioenergetic internalization.

investigations.name: og-06-chemistry-to-heredity
investigations.title: The First Heredity
investigations.objective: Does inherited state improve persistence/throughput — comparing RNA-like, peptide-assisted, compositional and hybrid heredity — rather than template replication in isolation? (Do NOT presume RNA.)
investigations.claim: An inherited chemical state improves lineage fitness above its replication cost when it clears the Eigen error threshold — but heredity need NOT presume a long high-fidelity RNA template. An agent-based lineage shows template heredity suffers the length catastrophe (Q=fidelity^length collapses with length) while compositional (GARD) and template-focused hybrid heredity persist length-independently (functional persistence ~0.88, seed-robust across the 5 graded seeds — 0.878±0.005, and 8/8 in a wider sweep) above the non-heritable control, which loses the parent↔offspring correlation and collapses. (A mean-field quasispecies arm still ranks a long high-fidelity template above a cheaper peptide module above non-inheritance when all clear the threshold.)

investigations.name: og-07-ecology-before-luca
investigations.title: Ecology Before LUCA
investigations.objective: In connected pore networks with cross-feeding, parasitism, cooperation and horizontal exchange, what emergent capabilities arise — compared to ancestral reconstructions, without assuming LUCA is primitive?
investigations.claim: A connected metacommunity of heterogeneous pore compartments develops functional redundancy (robustness) that an isolated compartment cannot — cross-feeding and horizontal transfer spread coarse-grained protometabolic capabilities into >= 2-fold coverage, so most functions survive a single-compartment loss. Robustness EMERGES only in a bounded corner of the swept phase maps — it needs enough inter-compartment diversity to give cross-feeding something to share AND enough exchange to spread it, and it collapses as parasite load rises — too little diversity leaves nothing to share, too little exchange leaves a broad repertoire fragile, and parasites draining their neighbours erase the redundancy. The three-view Decision map over (exchange_rate x parasite_load) at the canonical diversity shows cross-feeding robustness emerging only in the well-connected, low-parasite corner (PASS boundary at robustness 0.5). The collective repertoire's overlap with the anaerobic H2/CO2/FeS LUCA reconstruction is REPORTED as a far-end boundary the emergent set approaches (~0.6-0.7), not a target — LUCA constrains which capabilities are eventually acquired, not evidence the first compartments were LUCA-like.

investigations.name: og-08-escape-from-the-vent
investigations.title: Escape From the Vent
investigations.objective: What is the minimum set of innovations required for autonomous persistence away from the geological reactor, as environmental support is relaxed?
investigations.claim: Autonomy away from the geological reactor requires an irreducible innovation set — internal energy conversion (a pump), active resource import, and heredity to hold them. Because the lineage's budget is co-limited (it needs BOTH usable free energy AND usable resources, Liebig's minimum), a single innovation is a cost without a co-benefit; only the full set keeps the net budget above the survival floor as the external gradient, mineral access and feed are all withdrawn. A knockout sweep shows the full set persists off-gradient (surviving fraction 1.0) while removing any one innovation collapses persistence to 0 — so the minimum robust set for escaping the vent is {pump, importer, heredity}.

investigations.name: og-adv-generic-nonequilibrium
investigations.title: The Adversarial Control
investigations.objective: Does a generic nonequilibrium chemical system with no vent-specific features (no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalytic interface, no pore concentration) pass the vent-specific gates? It SHOULD NOT.
investigations.claim: The og-01/02/03 gates are vent-specific and falsifiable. A generic nonequilibrium control — the SAME real composites with no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalytic interface and no pore concentration — is rejected by every discriminating gate (carbon flux, formate yield, protometabolic throughput, thermophoretic Péclet, enrichment), while the vent passes all five. So a PASS elsewhere in the campaign certifies the vent MECHANISM, not merely "some nonequilibrium chemistry".
baseline_names: Generic non-vent control (carbon-fixation composite, vent features off)

investigations.name: og-cal-vent-environment
investigations.title: Calibrating the Vent: What Fraction of Observed-Consistent Vent States Feed Downstream Chemistry
investigations.objective: Model Upgrade plan, Phase 1 (priority upgrade A). og-00 showed the real PHREEQC + FiPy vent settles in the Lost City window over ~80% of a swept grid — but the fraction of a chosen grid that passes is not a probability of feasibility, and sweep bounds can determine apparent robustness. Conditioning on observed systems instead: of the vent states consistent with the Lost City field observations (outlet T, pH, dissolved H2), what fraction also satisfies what og-01's carbon fixation needs (H2 >= 1 mM at the interface, a >= 3-unit pH gradient, T inside validity)? Which observation binds, which parameters does it pin, and does the answer depend on whether the vent wall convects?
investigations.claim: Conditioning the real vent on field observations turns og-00's "80% of a swept grid is habitable" into a posterior statement: 12.5% of the empirically motivated prior reproduces Lost City, the dissolved-H2 observation does all the work (pH is buffered, T is loose), and 100% of that posterior supplies the H2 and pH gradient downstream carbon fixation requires — a result that does not depend on whether the wall convects, and that identifies the DIC prior and the equilibrium-vs-kinetic carbon-redox assumption as the decisions that move it.

investigations.name: og-energy-proto-energetics
investigations.title: The Energy Currency
investigations.objective: Can a primitive system capture environmental (geochemical) free energy into a transferable chemical currency — charged by an exergonic drive, spent on endergonic work, lost to hydrolysis — before any modern-style ion pumping, and what fraction of the geochemical free energy becomes stored usable work?
investigations.claim: A pre-ATP thioester-class carrier coupled to an exergonic geochemical drive maintains a transferable energy currency under endergonic load (charged fraction ~0.39) and captures ~47% of the tapped geochemical free energy as stored usable work; removing the coupling or starving the drive below the carrier bond collapses the currency — capturing free energy into a transferable store is an explicit, bounded, falsifiable transition, not a favourable reaction direction.

investigations.name: og-growth-division
investigations.title: Growth and Division
investigations.objective: Does an internal autocatalytic/metabolic chemistry change a compartment's PHYSICAL fate — accumulating product, generating osmotic pressure, drawing in solvent, expanding, and forcing division — and under what permeability regime does it divide rather than lyse or starve?
investigations.claim: A protocell's chemistry can change its physical fate. An internal autocatalytic/metabolic source makes an osmolyte; its accumulation raises the internal osmotic pressure (van 't Hoff), that pressure draws solvent across the semi-permeable membrane, the compartment expands, and at a size threshold it divides — a physical selection mechanism with no abstract fitness score. Whether this produces division rather than lysis or starvation is set by the membrane permeability against the network throughput — there is a bounded viable band in which net growth leads to repeated division, flanked by starvation (too permeable — the product leaks before the osmotic pressure can build) and lysis (too impermeable — the pressure bursts the membrane). Mass is conserved to machine precision across growth and division.
baseline_names: Metabolism to osmotic growth and division (favorable)

investigations.name: og-res-nitrogen-assimilation
investigations.title: The Nitrogen Bottleneck
investigations.objective: Carbon fixation is not the only requirement for a protocell. Can an FeS-mediated vent reduce the early ocean's oxidised / inert nitrogen (NO3-/NO2-/N2) to ammonium fast enough to keep pace with carbon fixation, and which conditions (FeS activity, nitrate supply, temperature) decide whether nitrogen becomes limiting first?
investigations.claim: FeS-mediated reduction of oxidised/inert nitrogen supplies ammonium and amino-acid precursors fast enough to keep pace with carbon fixation (C:N supply ratio near Redfield) only inside a bounded region of (nitrate supply x FeS activity); outside it nitrogen — not carbon or energy — becomes the first limiting resource.
baseline_names: Nitrogen as a limiting resource — favourable

investigations.name: og-res-phosphorus-availability
investigations.title: The Phosphorus Bottleneck
investigations.objective: Phosphorus may be a harder bottleneck than carbon. Can the same thermal-gradient vent pore that concentrates C and N also co-concentrate P — tracking dissolved phosphate, mineral-bound P, polyphosphate and reactive P with explicit precipitation/adsorption loss — or does phosphate precipitate/adsorb before it is chemically useful? Are there local windows where reactive P is produced faster than it is lost?
investigations.claim: A real libRoadRunner P-speciation network coupled to the og-03 thermal pore shows reactive phosphorus becomes available only in a bounded (phosphate source × pore enrichment) window where condensation + activation outrun the precipitation/adsorption sink; the same pore enrichment that concentrates carbon co-concentrates P, and without the gradient phosphate precipitates before it is useful — phosphorus is a localization-gated bottleneck, not a free resource.
